title: Taskboard: add a task and finish it
subtitle: What the quickstart example records: a 30-second narrated walkthrough of a tiny static app, built from `scenes.json`.

sections.heading: What the video shows
sections.md:
- The board with three columns: **To do**, **In progress**, **Done**.
- A new task added through the dialog, typed character by character.
- The task marked done, with the camera zoomed in on the cursor.
- The weekly summary further down the page.

stills.caption: The new task in the **Done** column.

sections.heading: Try it on your app
sections.md: Copy `scenes.json`, point `baseUrl` at your app and rewrite the scenes. Or ask Claude: *make an explainer video of the settings page*.
